subject: ETA: Staggered lane commitment and cloud-burst sync
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Sylvia Gomez <sylvia.gomez@oemtech.com>, Amit Rana <amit.rana@strata-cloud.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: ETA: Staggered lane commitment and cloud-burst sync

Hi Sylvia & Amit,

Following our call last week with Stratos Labs (Daniel copied), we need to align on concrete ETA windows and a coordinated mitigation path: OEM lead times are the gating factor for Dedicated capacity on this deal, and the customer wants a phased onramp with the option to temporarily burst in the cloud while final SKUs ship.

Ask: can OEM and Strata-cloud confirm the following by EOD Thursday so we can finalize the mutual action plan for DL-7832?

  - OEM: firm shipping windows for two tranches (Tranche A: 50 units, Tranche B: 150 units) and earliest configurable assembly start date.
  - OEM: where we sit in your manufacturing queue (queue position or ordinal estimate) and what would move us up (PO + deposit cadence).
  - Strata-cloud: available burst capacity windows (hourly slots per week), lead time for reserved instances if we choose to reserve, and minimum commitment terms.

Attached: preliminary sizing and the draft OEM quote we received from your team earlier (OEM_ETA_Quote_Strata_v2.pdf, Redwood_sizing_v1.xlsx).

We want to propose a "staggered-lane" approach: Tranche A ships to staging 6-8 weeks earlier to unblock early customer validation; Tranche B follows in a second manufacturing batch. If OEM lead time pushes beyond 12 weeks, we trigger cloud-burst credits + a discounted reserved slot for Stratos to keep their app live.

Internal notes for Ben/Marissa/Karthik: if Sylvia can give a firm queue slot and deposit schedule, Ben can prepare a PO, Marissa will coordinate customs & staging, and Karthik will confirm routing/region capacity.

Thanks — Neha

--
Neha Kapoor
Sr. Solutions Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com | +1-415-555-0192
Redwood Inference
From: Sylvia Gomez <sylvia.gomez@oemtech.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@stratoslabs.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ETA: Staggered lane commitment and cloud-burst sync

Neha, Daniel —

Thanks for the clear summary. Quick answers and constraints from OEM side:

  - Current slot: we can confirm manufacturing queue position ~18 as of today for the 80XX GPU chassis family. That translates to an estimated ship start of ~9–11 weeks from Purchase Order (PO) receipt.
  - Tranche breakdown: we can split current allocation into a small early-build (Tranche A = 40 units) and a larger follow-up (Tranche B = 160 units). A 30% deposit on PO moves you up approximately 4-6 positions (rough estimate).
  - Configurable assembly: earliest configurable build window opens 5 business days after a signed order spec sheet and component lock.

Risks to call out: customs hold times at port X have been spiking (add ~5 business days potential), and a single critical capacitor supplier has a 6-week backlog for the S-level board — any change to that BOM will re-baseline delivery.

Attachment: OEM_ETA_Quote_Strata_v2.pdf (quote with tentative slot and deposit schedule).

We can commit to providing a firm ship-by range once PO + spec sheet are locked and deposit hits our account. If Redwood/Stratos want to prioritize us on the line, provide a firm PO with the 30% deposit and an acceptance window for component choices.

Regards,
Sylvia

--
Sylvia Gomez
Head of Enterprise Accounts | OEMTech Manufacturing
sylvia.gomez@oemtech.com | +1-503-555-2910
From: Amit Rana <amit.rana@strata-cloud.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@stratoslabs.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 13:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ETA: Staggered lane commitment and cloud-burst sync

Neha, team —

We can support the proposed staggered-lane approach from the cloud side. Summary of what Strata can offer immediately:

  - On-demand burst pool: up to 250 vGPU-equivalent slots, available in week-long reservations on a rolling basis. We can guarantee contiguous 72-hour heavy-burst windows if scheduled 48 hours in advance.
  - Reserved bridge: 3-month bridge reserved instances available on a month-to-month payment schedule (minimum 2-month notice to cancel). Pricing and credits: we can offer 20% off list for any burst usage that exceeds 6000 compute-hours in the month as a credit against future reserved purchases.
  - Activation lead time: on-demand burst is immediate; reserved bridge requires ~5 business days for contractual setup and IAM/network plumbing.

Operational notes: we'll need Redwood's routing policy for failover (which region to prefer, fallback thresholds). Karthik — can you confirm target region and whether the customer requires VPC peering or transit?

If Sylvia's team can push Tranche A by 4-6 positions with deposit, this reduces the total cloud-burst exposure and gives Stratos time to stage reserved capacity aligned to expected ship dates.

Regards,
Amit

--
Amit Rana
Strategic Partnerships | Strata Cloud Services
amit.rana@strata-cloud.com | +1-212-555-8844
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Sylvia Gomez <sylvia.gomez@oemtech.com>, Amit Rana <amit.rana@strata-cloud.com>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@stratoslabs.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ETA: Staggered lane commitment and cloud-burst sync

Thanks all — quick internal actions:

  1) I'll draft the PO tonight referencing OEM_ETA_Quote_Strata_v2.pdf and include the 30% deposit option to request queue uplift. Target: submit PO by EOW (Fri).
  2) Marissa — please flag customs team to create a customs-hold contingency (pre-clear docs) and prepare a staging checklist for Tranche A receiving (40 units).
  3) Karthik — confirm routing preference for Stratos (us-west-2 preferred) and whether VPC peering is required; if yes, we'll run the network checklist and share with Amit (5 business-day setup).

If Sylvia can confirm a tightened ship window after PO, we'll share an estimated calendar with Strata so they can provision the 72-hour burst windows in the weeks leading up to arrival.

Neha — can you please consolidate Sylvia's final ship-by window and Amit's tentative reserved-bridge SLA into a single MAL (mutual action list) doc so we can get sign-off from Stratos Labs? I'll attach the PO draft once it's ready.

Short, clear next steps appreciated.

Cheers,
Ben
